title: MulmoTerminal — put your own chip on the header
description: Short feature clip. The cell header takes chips of your own beside the built-in ones; this one names the worktree the cell is in, so starting an issue from the list shows the tree it cut. Opt-in, and there is no Settings page for it. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Add a chip of your own to the header. This one names the worktree.

beats.text: Chips have no Settings page. You write them in your config file.

html: MulmoTerminalnpx mulmoterminal@latestMIT · receptron.github.io/mulmoterminal
Header Chips
<div class='absolute rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 font-mono text-2xl text-slate-200 leading-relaxed' style='top:180px;left:120px;right:120px;padding:36px 44px'>

{ "chips": ["git", "ctx", "diff", "usage",
{ "label": "Which worktree this cell is on",
